text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Air Groove is in the lead! She's
done it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has made history on the turf
today as
she continues her mother's
legacy! We have a new
queen today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I... really won?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing, Air Groove! Three
cheers for
the new queen!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hip hip hooray! Congrats on following
your
mother's legacy!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's real... I'm the new Queen of the
Oaks. Which
means...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Just... wow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could be like her... So proud and
majestic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to greet Air Groove after her
incredible
victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes... I've finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have to admit that even I cannot
contain my
emotions right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was able to see the same view
my mother
did.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You've done well yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are aware that this is not the end,
correct? In
fact, this is only the
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Shuka Sho. We need to stay
focused
and keep our eyes on the prize.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... you're not sounding too bad
yourself.
When did you get so reliable?
choice_data_list: Now that's a true new queen.
Now that's a true new queen, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep that up from here on out, and
there may be
hope for you yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove graces me with a regal smile.
